from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A paper from the provided collection, including its title and outgoing reference links to other provided papers."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of the paper")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="List of titles of other papers from the collection that this paper references in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for all parsed papers from the document collection."""
    papers: list[Paper]
